text:
ashley: Heads-up — hitting TLS errors using Python SDK from inside our VPC behind corporate proxy. SDK ignores our custom CA and base_url override. Running Dedicated/private.

miranda: Ugh. Can you paste a tiny repro? Are you setting env vars or passing base_url to the client?

ashley: Minimal repro below. SDK ends up calling public api instead of our VPC endpoint and cert validation fails.

ashley: ```python
from redwood import InferenceClient
c = InferenceClient(base_url="https://redwood-private.internal", api_key="x...")
resp = c.generate("hello")
print(resp)
```

sam: Two quick checks: which HTTP backend (requests vs httpx) and is the proxy doing TLS interception?

ashley: Sync Python -> requests backend. Yes, our proxy does MITM with a company CA. I tried REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/certs/company.pem and SSL_CERT_FILE, still fails.

dennis: Saw this last week. Client constructor ignores verify/ca paths in some code paths. There's an older issue about injecting a custom session/client — customers need it for proxies + CAs.

miranda: Workaround if SDK supports it: create a requests.Session and pass it in.

miranda: ```python
import requests
from redwood import InferenceClient
s = requests.Session()
s.verify = "/etc/certs/company.pem"
s.trust_env = True  # let REQUESTS_* envs apply
c = InferenceClient(base_url="https://redwood-private.internal", http_session=s, api_key="...")
```

ashley: I have 0.9.1 from pip — no http_session arg: TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'http_session'

sam: That confirms an SDK parity/typing bug. Docs mention http_transport for async but not a sync session injection. We should add http_session (sync) and http_client (async) injection points and update stubs.

dennis: Also found inconsistent base_url resolution: some code paths prefer REDWOOD_API_BASE env over constructor arg. For Dedicated/Private we need deterministic precedence: constructor arg > REDWOOD_API_BASE env > defaults.

ashley: Yes please. Our onboarding is blocked for two enterprise tenants.

miranda: Filed DEVEX-4523 with repro, traces, and tests: matrix covers sync/async, requests/httpx, env vs arg, custom CA. Linked to ticket.

ops-bot: @channel Affected customers: internal staging + two enterprise tenants in us-west. Ops applied a temporary validation fallback for staging.

sam: Short-term patch proposal: 1) ensure base_url kwarg honored everywhere, 2) accept verify/ca_bundle param (path or bool), 3) add http_session/http_client injection, 4) surface clear cert-failure guidance in error messages.

dennis: For async, make sure we accept an AsyncClient and don't close user-supplied clients. Update typing to reflect AsyncClient | None and proper context manager behavior.

ashley: Can we get a hotfix release? Enterprise onboarding blocked.

miranda: I'll prioritize as a patch release. Plan: PR with tests, docs sample for VPC+proxy+CA, add example in examples/private-proxy/, and cut a patch wheel. Will ping for reviews on API design.

sam: Also recommend honoring REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and SSL_CERT_FILE by default and respecting trust_env so customers behind proxies get expected behavior.

ashley: Thanks — will test the patched wheel in staging when it's available. :raised_hands:

miranda: PR inbound, linking in the ticket. Ping me if you want to review the session/httpx API.
